sentences.en: My cousin is the last person to break his promise.
sentences.zh: 我的堂兄弟绝不会食言。

sentences.en: My cousin was familiar with trouble when he was young.
sentences.zh: 我这个堂兄弟年轻时就经常惹麻烦。

sentences.en: The mere sight of the doctor made my cousin afraid.
sentences.zh: 医生一出现，我的堂兄就害怕得不得了。

senses.zh: 堂[表]兄弟[姊妹]远亲, 同辈, 同胞
Cousin库辛（Victor， 1792-1867， 法国哲学家、教育改革家； 折衷主义的创始人）形容词:cousinly
